system.description:
She moves abstract just like a shadow dancing on the edge, like a storm cloud passing overhead, hypnotizing me.

—Dillinger Escape Plan, One of Us is the Killer

Dancers are practitioners of the alluring art of dance. They have a flair for enlivening their audience and giving awe-inspiring shows.

Iconic Dancers

  • Apsalar, Malazan Book of the Fallen
  • Azura, Fire Emblem Fates
  • Sandilene fa Toren, The Circle Opens

Playing Dancer

The dancer is a low-defense support with a focus on action efficiency. Grant Actions through Step Up, as your main offenses will occur when you Crit on Reflex Saves.

Action: Attack
Move: Midline (Step Up)
Starting Pack: Courtesan or Musician
Key Stat: Dexterity
Complexity: ★★☆☆☆
Training: Finesse, Performance

levelFeatures.name: Step Up
levelFeatures.description: Once per Round when you Move, you can make a Finesse Check. On a pass, one Being of your choice other than yourself that sees you can immediately take an extra Action.

levelFeatures.name: Footloose
levelFeatures.description: You gain the Fallaway Reverse Perk and, when you make a Reflex Save, roll two d20s and use the higher result.

levelFeatures.name: Evasive (10’)
levelFeatures.description: Once per Round after another Being uses an Action or Move, you can Move 10’ without using Speed and can continue moving using your remaining Speed. This free Speed increases by 5’ every 4 Levels hereafter.

levelFeatures.name: Perk
levelFeatures.description: Choose a new Perk. You must meet the prerequisites to take it, unless the Perk is granted through a Class Feature.

levelFeatures.name: Captivator (Cd4)
levelFeatures.description:
When you pass a Finesse Check or Crit on any Save, you can cause a Being that can see you to become Berserk, Charmed, Confused, or Frightened for Cd4 Rounds. Once this ends, they are immune to this Ability for the Shift.

This countdown die increases to a Cd6 at 8th Level.

levelFeatures.name: Don’t Stop Me Now
levelFeatures.description: Difficult Terrain doesn’t impede your walking Speed, and you have Favor on Saves against being Paralyzed, Restrained, grappled, or moved.
